Results.ReviewText: The Weber Kettle Master Touch is my second Weber Kettle Grill. I have had my first Weber Premium Kettle for about 5 years and use it in a different location. I love the grill. It is the perfect platform for heat. Whether it is a high temperature sear, low and slow or anything in between it is easy to do with the kettle. I have an expensive ceramic smoker and a nice gas grill, but they are seldom used. I prefer to cook on the Kettle. The lid bale is a great feature, much easier to use than the hook on the Premium lid. The gourmet system cooking grate is also a nice feature. I have not added any of the accessories but I really like that you can remove the center circle of the grate and use it separately. I lay it directly on my charcoal baskets when I want to get a high temperature sear on a steak. With out that, I would have to elevate the baskets on bricks to get the coals immediately under the cooking grate. There are endless videos on YouTube from expert grillers on how to use the kettle for various types of cooking. Those have helped me really exploit the Kettle for all it can do.
Results.Title: My Favorite Grill Ever

Results.ReviewText: First charcoal grill in over 20 years. Learning a lot in first few weeks of use. Some great, some good, some bad. We have made some great meals. Smoked pork butt, requires lots of interaction and attention, but turned out nice. Adding coals for extended indirect cooking through grate side access not the easiest. Beer can chicken was awesome with addition of a hickory wood block to coals. Hard to beat burgers and steaks on charcoal. Timing a little more challenging than on my gas grill. Master touch series Grill has removable cutout in center of grate. When removing grate to start charcoal with Weber chimney, must set grate on a flat surface or, center cut out will fall out and first time, rolled into pool. Speaking of chimney, tried two different chimneys and Weber model clearly better. Sturdier and easier to use than cheaper model. Mild buyers remorse that I did not get Weber grill cart combo. Is it correct that you can’t order the cart as an add on accessory? All in all it has made grilling more fun and more tasty, with just a bit of additional work and slightly less convenience than gas grill. Since we grill year round in Florida it will definitely get a workout and we will no doubt learn even more.
Results.Title: Florida Grilling

14516001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs.
